tools.name: create_poll
tools.description: Create a Pickly poll to help a group decide something together (where to eat, which date, what to watch) and get a link to share in the group chat. Nobody needs an account to vote.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Read the current standings of a Pickly poll: who's winning, by how much, and whether voting has closed. With the poll's manage key it also lists suggestions waiting for review.

tools.name: review_suggestion
tools.description: Approve or turn down an option a voter suggested on a poll this chat made (it needs the manage key). Approved suggestions become options everyone can vote on. Check with the person before deciding for them.

tools.name: review_voter_request
tools.description: On a poll that shows who voted, add someone who asked to be on the list of names, or turn them down (needs the manage key). Check with the person before deciding for them.

tools.name: close_poll
tools.description: Stop voting on a poll this chat made (it needs the manage key) and get the final results. Only when the person asks: it can only be reopened from the manage link.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_poll, get_results, review_suggestion, review_voter_request, close_poll · Public sink: create_poll.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_poll, get_results, review_suggestion, review_voter_request, close_poll · Public sink: create_poll

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_results" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read the current standings of a Pickly poll: who's winning, by how much, and whether voting has closed." → after: "Read the current standings of a Pickly poll: who's winning, by how much, and whether voting has closed. With the poll's manage key it also lists suggestions waiting for review."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
